title: ClickHouse vs StarRocks: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
ClickHouse vs StarRocks: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: ClickHouse excels at raw ingestion & scan speeds. StarRocks offers more balanced performance with better point lookups.
• Latency: Both offer low latency, but StarRocks often has an edge for complex queries due to its vectorized execution & optimizer.
• Consistency: StarRocks provides stronger consistency guarantees (ACID compliant) out-of-the-box, while ClickHouse leans towards eventual consistency.
• Failure Modes: ClickHouse has a mature distributed setup. StarRocks is also robust but might have a slightly higher operational complexity for some.
• Operational Overhead: ClickHouse can be simpler to set up initially. StarRocks offers more advanced features that might require more tuning.

Recommendation: For pure analytical speed and simpler setups, ClickHouse is great. For balanced OLAP needs with stronger consistency and easier integration with transactional workloads, StarRocks is a strong contender.
